positive_box_assessment: All 13 predictions point at the queried target in the current image. Several close wrist boxes include occluding grippers/background. No manually drawn gold boxes; this is not an IoU claim or blanket box-label approval.
findings: Radio side/top views are often missed or uncertain, even when red-white body is visibly identifiable.
Close wastebasket interior/rim views are often missed or uncertain.
Many robot-shell or unrelated wrist images are uncertain instead of absent.
Plates with visible food are usually recognized; a plate back cannot prove food remains on top.
A few frozen labels involve severe fragments; retain the original baseline, do not relabel to improve the teacher score.
limits: TRAIN-only teacher calibration, not heldout generalization or full robot success.
Domain/class-appearance mismatch is a supported hypothesis, not a proven exclusive cause.
Format validity and successful process exit do not make these labels training-ready.
next: One separately registered TRAIN-reference appearance calibration; no mass pseudo-label release from H81.
